description: The Board-page features: officer-managed Events (data + UI + list/schedule integration), the per-account personal task tracker (task_completions data + checkbox + filter + viewer-dependent glow), and the Month calendar view. Grounded in design.md Data layer, Components -> Events/Personal tracker/Month calendar, and Error handling. Depends on FEAT-001 (tables/publication), FEAT-002 (types, pure fns, tokens), and FEAT-003 (App shell / Layout rendered via PageRouter).
steps: Events data: create src/data/useEvents.ts as useRealtimeTable<EventRow, EventItem>('events', rowToEvent) exactly like src/data/useTasks.ts. Extend src/data/mutations.ts with addEvent(input)/updateEvent(id, patch)/removeEvent(id) using classify/MutationResult, sending '' (not null) for empty location/notes and never checking client role.

Events UI: create src/components/EventBadge.tsx (token background per type + inline SVG icon in the Header icon style + text label; icons: school_event=calendar-star, quiz=clipboard-question, exam=document-check, presentation=presentation-screen) so type is never color-only. Create src/components/AddEventDialog.tsx: officer-only form opened from a new 'Add Event' button next to 'Add task' in TaskList (shown only when isOfficer); fields type <select>, title (required), subject <select> (optional '— none —'), CalendarField date, optional start/end <input type=time> (client enforces: end only if start present, end >= start), location, notes; submit via addEvent; shared Modal; no optimistic UI (reconciles via realtime like AddTaskDialog).

List integration: in src/components/TaskList.tsx merge tasks + events through the shared CalendarItem shape from calendar.ts with the design's explicit sort (datePart asc; kind-order tasks-before-events as tie-break; startTime asc nulls-last; title asc); React key `${kind}:${id}`; render events via EventBadge; event rows read-only for members with officer edit/remove affordances (RLS-backed). Wire useEvents into Layout and pass events to TaskList, ScheduleGrid, and MonthCalendar.

Schedule badge: in src/components/ScheduleCell.tsx render the upcoming-assessment corner marker when hasUpcomingAssessment(subject.id, events, today) — a shape/icon/token (--assess-badge) distinct from the pending dot, with sr-only '(assessment within 7 days)'. Thread events from Layout through ScheduleGrid to ScheduleCell.

Tracker data: factor a useRealtimeTableKeyed variant out of src/data/useRealtimeTable.ts taking keyOf(row) for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE reconcile (base useRealtimeTable stays id-keyed and its tests unaffected). Create src/data/useTaskCompletions.ts: session-aware, keyed on `${user_id}:${task_id}`, exposing completedTaskIds: Set<string> + raw rows; on sign-in/mount fetch own rows + subscribe; on sign-out tear down + reset the set to empty; re-key the effect on the session user id. Add src/data/useTaskCompletions.test.ts covering keyed reconcile + the session transitions (empty signed-out, populate on sign-in, reset on sign-out, re-key on user change).

Tracker mutations: extend src/data/mutations.ts with OPTIMISTIC markTaskDone(taskId, userId) (insert { user_id, task_id }) and unmarkTaskDone(taskId, userId) (delete().match({ user_id, task_id })), documented as the one deliberate optimistic exception; caller updates completedTaskIds immediately, reverts on error; realtime reconcile is idempotent on the Set.

Tracker UI: in src/components/TaskRow.tsx add a leading <input type=checkbox> bound to completedTaskIds.has(task.id) (rendered only when signed in) calling markTaskDone/unmarkTaskDone; a completed row uses --task-done dim + line-through plus the checkbox state and sr-only '(done)'. In src/components/TaskList.tsx add the All / My-unfinished / My-finished segmented filter (shown only when signed in) deriving from completedTaskIds, and thread completedTaskIds + handlers to TaskRow.

Glow swap: replace subjectHasPending with subjectGlows(subjectId, tasks, viewer) in ScheduleGrid/ScheduleCell, deriving viewer from useSession + the completion set from useTaskCompletions (wired in Layout).

Month calendar: create src/components/BoardViewToggle.tsx ('Weekly schedule | Month calendar' segmented toggle; state in Layout; details panel + right list unchanged). Create src/components/MonthCalendar.tsx rendering buildMonthGrid as a 7-col Monday-first grid of focusable real <button> day cells (Enter/Space activate, --focus-ring), up to 3 EventBadge/task chips + '+N more' via visibleWithOverflow, prev/next/Today controls, isToday highlight, signed-in finished tasks dimmed via --task-done, click-a-day surfaces that day's items in DetailsPanel; responsive dots-per-day + below-list at the mobile breakpoint via a base.css media query (not JS). Layout renders ScheduleGrid or MonthCalendar per the toggle and feeds the clicked-day items to DetailsPanel; extend src/components/DetailsPanel.tsx to render a selected day's merged items.

Update co-located tests: TaskList.test.tsx and ScheduleCell.test.tsx for the merged-list shape, the completion checkbox, the viewer-dependent glow, and the assessment badge, preserving existing behavioral assertions.
acceptance_criteria: An officer-only Add Event control exists and addEvent/updateEvent/removeEvent go through mutations.ts trusting RLS; events render in the right-hand list with a type badge (icon + text, not color-only).

A signed-in user can toggle a task done/not-done via the checkbox with optimistic update; the row dims + strikes through with sr-only '(done)'; the All/My-unfinished/My-finished filter works; tasks.status is never written by this path.
subjectGlows drives the schedule glow (viewer-dependent) and ScheduleCell shows the distinct upcoming-assessment badge within 7 days.

The Board shows a Weekly | Month toggle; the month grid shows tasks on deadline date and events on event date as chips, '+N more' past 3, today highlighted, prev/next/Today work, finished tasks dimmed, day cells keyboard-activatable, clicking a day lists its items in DetailsPanel.
useRealtimeTable's base id-keyed behavior and tests are unchanged.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test` and confirm both pass, including the updated TaskList.test.tsx / ScheduleCell.test.tsx and the new useTaskCompletions.test.ts.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm it passes.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds.
findings:
Board features landed. Verification green: typecheck 0 errors, lint 0 errors (3 pre-existing context-provider react-refresh warnings only), 168 passed / 9 skipped (RLS integration suite skips as expected; +16 tests vs the 152 baseline), build OK. No new runtime dep.

Data layer:
- src/data/useEvents.ts — useRealtimeTable<EventRow,EventItem>('events', rowToEvent); public, live for everyone. Wired in Layout and passed to TaskList, ScheduleGrid, MonthCalendar.
- src/data/useRealtimeTable.ts — factored useRealtimeTableKeyed<Row,T>(table, mapRow, keyOfRow, keyOfItem, pollMs) that reconciles by an arbitrary string key. BASE useRealtimeTable<Row extends Identified,...> now delegates to it with id extractors; its id-keyed behavior/tests are UNCHANGED. The reconcile payload is typed loosely as RealtimePostgresChangesPayload<{[key:string]:any}> and rows are cast to Row (so a composite-PK table without an `id` column works). NOTE: task_completions is NOT read through useRealtimeTableKeyed directly — useTaskCompletions implements its own session-aware fetch/subscribe (keyed on `${user_id}:${task_id}`) because it needs the sign-in/out/user-change lifecycle; useRealtimeTableKeyed stays available for any future keyed-but-session-agnostic table.
- src/data/useTaskCompletions.ts — session-aware hook. Exposes { completedTaskIds: Set<string>, rows: TaskCompletion[], addLocal(taskId), removeLocal(taskId) }. Re-keys the effect on session.user.id: signed-out resets to empty + no subscription; sign-in/mount fetches own rows (user_id=eq) + subscribes with a user_id filter; user change tears down A and fetches B. addLocal/removeLocal are the optimistic set mutators the TaskList toggle calls. Covered by src/data/useTaskCompletions.test.ts (empty-signed-out, populate-on-sign-in, keyed INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE + idempotent duplicate INSERT, reset-on-sign-out, re-key on user change) which mocks ../lib/supabase (from().select().eq() + channel().on().subscribe() capturing the reconcile cb) and ../context/SessionProvider.
- src/data/mutations.ts — added addEvent(input)/updateEvent(id,patch)/removeEvent(id) (classify/MutationResult, no client role check; subject_id/start_time/end_time send null for empty, location/notes send '' never null). Added the OPTIMISTIC markTaskDone(taskId,userId)=insert{user_id,task_id} and unmarkTaskDone(taskId,userId)=delete().match({user_id,task_id}) — documented as the one deliberate optimistic exception; never touches tasks.status.

Pure helpers (added to src/lib/calendar.ts, co-located tests in calendar.test.ts): taskToCalendarItem(task,done=false) (datePart=deadlineDatePart(deadline), startTime always null, done flag), eventToCalendarItem(event), compareCalendarItems(a,b) (datePart asc with EMPTY datePart last; kind tasks-before-events; startTime asc nulls-last; title asc), mergeCalendarItems(tasks,events,completedTaskIds=Set) => sorted CalendarItem[]. FEAT-005/006 can reuse mergeCalendarItems/compare if they need a merged timeline, but they are board-specific today.

Components:
- src/components/EventBadge.tsx — <EventBadge type compact?/>; token bg per type + inline icon (school_event=calendar-star, quiz=clipboard-question, exam=document-check, presentation=presentation-screen) + text label; data-testid=`event-badge-${type}`. REUSE this for any event/status chip; it is the canonical 'type is never color-only' badge.
- src/components/AddEventDialog.tsx — officer-only; opened from the new 'Add Event' button in TaskList (next to 'Add task', isOfficer only). Fields: type <select>, title (req), subject <select> with '— none —', CalendarField date, start/end <input type=time> (client enforces end-needs-start and end>=start), location, notes. Submits addEvent; no optimistic UI (reconciles via realtime like AddTaskDialog).
- src/components/EventRow.tsx — read-only event row for members/anon; officer gets Remove (aria-label `Remove event ${title}`).
- src/components/TaskRow.tsx — now takes signedIn, completedForMe, onToggleCompletion. Leading <input type=checkbox> (rendered only when signedIn; aria-label `Mark ${subject} - ${title} done for me`); a completed row dims (--task-done) + line-through + sr-only ' (done)'. The officer class-status toggle label is still 'Mark done'/'Reopen' (distinct from the per-user checkbox).
- src/components/TaskList.tsx — PROPS CHANGED: now (subjects, tasks, events, completedTaskIds, onAddLocalCompletion, onRemoveLocalCompletion). Merges via mergeCalendarItems; React key `${kind}:${id}`; renders TaskRow or EventRow by kind. Segmented filter All/My-unfinished/My-finished (role=group aria-label 'Filter my tasks', shown only when signedIn; events always pass the filter). Empty copy: 'No tasks or events yet.' / 'Nothing matches this filter.'
- src/components/ScheduleCell.tsx — new optional `assessment` prop renders a DISTINCT bottom-right triangle marker (data-testid='assessment-badge', aria-hidden) + sr-only ' (assessment within 7 days)', separate from the round pending dot. The existing pending-dot cue is unchanged.
- src/components/ScheduleGrid.tsx — PROPS CHANGED: added events + viewer ({signedIn; completedTaskIds} | null). Glow now = subjectGlows(subject.id, tasks, viewer); assessment = hasUpcomingAssessment(subject.id, events).
- src/components/BoardViewToggle.tsx — exports type BoardView='weekly'|'month'; <BoardViewToggle view onChange/>.
- src/components/MonthCalendar.tsx — props (tasks, events, completedTaskIds, year, month0, onChangeMonth, selectedDay, onSelectDay). 7-col Monday-first grid of real <button> day cells, up to 3 chips + '+N more', prev/next/Today, isToday highlight, finished-task chips dimmed, click-day => onSelectDay. Responsive dots via base.css .mc-chips/.mc-dots media query (<=640px), NOT JS.
- src/components/DetailsPanel.tsx — added optional selectedDay + dayItems props: when selectedDay != null it renders that day's merged items (day mode); otherwise the original subject-pending behavior (now in an internal DetailsPanelSubject). Weekly view passes selectedDay=null.
- src/components/Layout.tsx — wires useEvents + useTaskCompletions, owns view/month/selectedDay state, computes viewer + dayItems, feeds everything through. anyError now also watches eventsState.

Styles: src/styles/base.css gained .mc-dots/.mc-chips media-query swap at <=640px. tokens.css was NOT touched (FEAT-002 already added --ev-*, --status-*, --task-done, --assess-badge/-fg to both mode blocks).

Tests updated preserving existing assertions: TaskList.test.tsx (new prop shape, Add Event button, event badge render, officer event Remove, completion checkbox + filter visibility/behavior) and ScheduleCell.test.tsx (assessment-badge show/hide + distinctness). Base useRealtimeTable tests untouched (there is no useRealtimeTable.test file).

For FEAT-005/006 (Absences/Reviewers): the EventBadge/StatusBadge icon-plus-text pattern is the template for color-safe status pills; signedUrlFor + createAbsenceRequest/createReviewer etc. are NOT yet in mutations.ts (still to be added by those features per design).
